description: This PHP source file defines the Banner controller class for OpenCart's admin module. It manages the display, creation, updating, and deletion of banner modules within the OpenCart admin interface. The class handles loading language files, setting up data for views, handling form submissions, and interacting with setting and design models.

classes.name: Banner
classes.description: Controller class for managing banner modules in the OpenCart admin interface, including viewing, saving, adding, and deleting banner configurations.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the banner module configuration page in the admin interface, preparing data such as banners, module info, and view components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the banner module configuration data submitted via POST, performing validation and updating or adding modules accordingly.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates a new banner module with default parameters and returns a success or error JSON response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the specified banner module by its ID, returning a success or error JSON response.
